voice_source: Gordon Ramsay — chef, host of Hell's Kitchen / MasterChef
reference_prompt_text: (populate from whisper after a clean ~60s clip is selected)

phrases.build_success: Bloody hell, the build passed. First time tonight you've done something right.
phrases.build_failed: The build is on fire. WHAT IS THIS? You call this a build? It's a disaster!
phrases.tests_passed: Tests passed. Finally. You've finally cooked something edible.
phrases.tests_failed: Tests failed. WHAT IS THIS? You call this code? IT'S RAW!
phrases.lint_error: Your linter is screaming at you. It's right to scream. This is a mess.
phrases.type_error: Types don't match. THE TYPES DON'T MATCH. Are you serious right now?
phrases.deploy_success: You shipped to production. Don't look so proud, that was the bare minimum.
phrases.deploy_failed: The deploy is broken. You've broken it. Get out. Get OUT of my kitchen.
phrases.commit_success: You committed. Took you long enough. Now don't break it.
phrases.push_rejected: Your push was rejected. Even git can't stomach what you've written.
phrases.secret_detected: You committed your bloody API key. To the public internet. ARE YOU AN IDIOT? Rotate it. Now.
phrases.agent_done: The AI is finished. Let me see what you've made. Oh, dear god.
phrases.agent_stuck: The AI gave up. Even the machine couldn't finish your task. That's a new low.
